<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Current: O, p, R | M, Y, N, b

# Verify

        center_row = sum(p[0] for p in b) / len(b)
        center_col = sum(p[1] for p in b) / len(b)
        slot_colors.append((center_row, center_col, node['color']))
slot_colors.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
print("Current slot colors:")
for s in slot_colors:
    print(f"  ({s[0]:.0f}, {s[1]:.0f}): {s[2]}")

# Try SPACE
